pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'themeVariables': { 'primaryColor': '#ffffff', 'primaryTextColor': '#000000', 'primaryBorderColor': '#000000', 'lineColor': '#000000', 'actorBkg': '#ffffff', 'actorBorder': '#000000', 'actorTextColor': '#000000', 'signalColor': '#000000', 'signalTextColor': '#000000', 'labelBoxBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'labelBoxBorderColor': '#000000', 'labelTextColor': '#000000', 'loopTextColor': '#000000', 'noteBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'noteBorderColor': '#000000', 'noteTextColor': '#000000', 'activationBorderColor': '#000000', 'activationBkgColor': '#ffffff'}}}%%\nsequenceDiagram\n autonumber\n actor Client as Client (App/Web)\n participant AuthCtrl as AuthController\n participant AuthSvc as AuthService\n participant Hasher as PasswordHasher\n participant UOW as UnitOfWork\n participant EmailSvc as EmailService\n participant SMTP as SMTP Server\n\n %% 1. User Registration Flow\n Client->>AuthCtrl: POST /api/v1/auth/register (RegisterRequest)\n activate AuthCtrl\n AuthCtrl->>AuthSvc: RegisterAsync(request)\n activate AuthSvc\n \n AuthSvc->>UOW: Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Email == email)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>AuthSvc: Return existing user (or null)\n deactivate UOW\n \n alt Email already registered & confirmed\n AuthSvc-->>AuthCtrl: Throw AppException(409, \"Email registered\")\n AuthCtrl-->>Client: 409 Conflict Response\n else New Valid Registration\n AuthSvc->>Hasher: Hash(request.Password)\n activate Hasher\n Hasher-->>AuthSvc: Return passwordHash\n deactivate Hasher\n \n AuthSvc->>AuthSvc: Generate EmailConfirmToken & Expiry (30 mins)\n \n activate UOW\n AuthSvc->>UOW: Users.Add(user)\n AuthSvc->>UOW: SaveChangesAsync()\n UOW-->>AuthSvc: DB Save Success\n deactivate UOW\n \n AuthSvc->>EmailSvc: SendEmailConfirmationAsync(email, name, userId, token)\n activate EmailSvc\n EmailSvc->>SMTP: Connect & Send Email\n activate SMTP\n SMTP-->>EmailSvc: Sent Success\n deactivate SMTP\n EmailSvc-->>AuthSvc: Task Complete\n deactivate EmailSvc\n \n AuthSvc-->>AuthCtrl: Return UserResponse\n deactivate AuthSvc\n AuthCtrl-->>Client: 201 Created (ApiResponse<UserResponse>)\n end\n deactivate AuthCtrl\n\n %% 2. Email Confirmation Sub-flow\n note over Client, SMTP: User clicks link in Email: /confirm-email?userId=x&token=y\n Client->>AuthCtrl: POST /api/v1/auth/confirm-email (ConfirmEmailRequest)\n activate AuthCtrl\n AuthCtrl->>AuthSvc: ConfirmEmailAsync(request)\n activate AuthSvc\n \n AuthSvc->>UOW: Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Email == email)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>AuthSvc: Return User Entity\n deactivate UOW\n \n AuthSvc->>AuthSvc: Verify EmailConfirmToken & TokenExpiresAt\n alt Token Valid\n AuthSvc->>AuthSvc: Set EmailConfirmed = true, Token = null\n activate UOW\n AuthSvc->>UOW: SaveChangesAsync()\n UOW-->>AuthSvc: DB Save Success\n deactivate UOW\n AuthSvc-->>AuthCtrl: Success\n AuthCtrl-->>Client: 200 OK (\"Email confirmed successfully\")\n else Invalid / Expired Token\n AuthSvc-->>AuthCtrl: Throw AppException(400, \"Invalid or expired token\")\n AuthCtrl-->>Client: 400 Bad Request\n end\n deactivate AuthSvc\n deactivate AuthCtrl",
 "config": null

tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'themeVariables': { 'primaryColor': '#ffffff', 'primaryTextColor': '#000000', 'primaryBorderColor': '#000000', 'lineColor': '#000000', 'actorBkg': '#ffffff', 'actorBorder': '#000000', 'actorTextColor': '#000000', 'signalColor': '#000000', 'signalTextColor': '#000000', 'labelBoxBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'labelBoxBorderColor': '#000000', 'labelTextColor': '#000000', 'loopTextColor': '#000000', 'noteBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'noteBorderColor': '#000000', 'noteTextColor': '#000000', 'activationBorderColor': '#000000', 'activationBkgColor': '#ffffff'}}}%%\nsequenceDiagram\n autonumber\n actor Client as Client (App/Web)\n participant AuthCtrl as AuthController\n participant AuthSvc as AuthService\n participant Hasher as PasswordHasher\n participant JwtSvc as JwtService\n participant UOW as UnitOfWork\n\n %% 1. User Login Flow\n Client->>AuthCtrl: POST /api/v1/auth/login (LoginRequest)\n activate AuthCtrl\n AuthCtrl->>AuthSvc: LoginAsync(request)\n activate AuthSvc\n \n AuthSvc->>UOW: Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Email == email)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>AuthSvc: Return User Entity (or null)\n deactivate UOW\n \n AuthSvc->>Hasher: Verify(request.Password, user.PasswordHash)\n activate Hasher\n Hasher-->>AuthSvc: Return verification result (true/false)\n deactivate Hasher\n\n alt Invalid Credentials / Unconfirmed Email / Locked Account\n AuthSvc-->>AuthCtrl: Throw AppException (401 / 403)\n AuthCtrl-->>Client: 401 Unauthorized / 403 Forbidden Response\n else Verification Success\n AuthSvc->>JwtSvc: CreateAccessToken(user)\n activate JwtSvc\n JwtSvc-->>AuthSvc: Return (accessToken, accessExpires)\n deactivate JwtSvc\n \n AuthSvc->>JwtSvc: CreateRefreshToken()\n activate JwtSvc\n JwtSvc-->>AuthSvc: Return (rawToken, tokenHash, refreshExpires)\n deactivate JwtSvc\n \n activate UOW\n AuthSvc->>UOW: RefreshTokens.Add(newRefreshToken)\n AuthSvc->>UOW: SaveChangesAsync()\n UOW-->>AuthSvc: DB Save Success\n deactivate UOW\n \n AuthSvc-->>AuthCtrl: Return LoginResponse (Tokens + UserDTO)\n deactivate AuthSvc\n AuthCtrl-->>Client: 200 OK (ApiResponse<LoginResponse>)\n end\n deactivate AuthCtrl\n\n %% 2. Token Refresh Rotation Sub-flow\n note over Client, UOW: Access Token Expired -> Refresh Token Rotation Invocation\n Client->>AuthCtrl: POST /api/v1/auth/refresh-token (RefreshTokenRequest)\n activate AuthCtrl\n AuthCtrl->>AuthSvc: RefreshAsync(request)\n activate AuthSvc\n \n AuthSvc->>JwtSvc: HashRefreshToken(request.RefreshToken)\n activate JwtSvc\n JwtSvc-->>AuthSvc: Return tokenHash\n deactivate JwtSvc\n \n AuthSvc->>UOW: RefreshTokens.Include(User).FirstOrDefaultAsync(t => t.TokenHash == hash)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>AuthSvc: Return Stored RefreshToken Entity\n deactivate UOW\n \n alt Token Revoked / Expired / User Inactive\n AuthSvc-->>AuthCtrl: Throw AppException(401, \"Invalid refresh token\")\n AuthCtrl-->>Client: 401 Unauthorized Response\n else Refresh Token Valid\n AuthSvc->>JwtSvc: CreateRefreshToken()\n activate JwtSvc\n JwtSvc-->>AuthSvc: Return (replacementRawToken, replacementHash, expires)\n deactivate JwtSvc\n \n AuthSvc->>AuthSvc: Revoke Stored Token (Set RevokedAt = Now)\n \n activate UOW\n AuthSvc->>UOW: RefreshTokens.Add(replacementRefreshToken)\n AuthSvc->>JwtSvc: CreateAccessToken(user)\n activate JwtSvc\n JwtSvc-->>AuthSvc: Return new Access Token\n deactivate JwtSvc\n \n AuthSvc->>UOW: SaveChangesAsync()\n UOW-->>AuthSvc: DB Save Success\n deactivate UOW\n \n AuthSvc-->>AuthCtrl: Return New LoginResponse\n deactivate AuthSvc\n AuthCtrl-->>Client: 200 OK (ApiResponse<LoginResponse>)\n end\n deactivate AuthCtrl",
 "config": null

 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'themeVariables': { 'primaryColor': '#ffffff', 'primaryTextColor': '#000000', 'primaryBorderColor': '#000000', 'lineColor': '#000000', 'actorBkg': '#ffffff', 'actorBorder': '#000000', 'actorTextColor': '#000000', 'signalColor': '#000000', 'signalTextColor': '#000000', 'labelBoxBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'labelBoxBorderColor': '#000000', 'labelTextColor': '#000000', 'loopTextColor': '#000000', 'noteBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'noteBorderColor': '#000000', 'noteTextColor': '#000000', 'activationBorderColor': '#000000', 'activationBkgColor': '#ffffff'}}}%%\nsequenceDiagram\n autonumber\n actor Client as Client (App/Web)\n participant AuthCtrl as AuthController\n participant AuthSvc as AuthService\n participant Hasher as PasswordHasher\n participant EmailSvc as EmailService\n participant UOW as UnitOfWork\n\n %% 1. Forgot Password Flow\n Client->>AuthCtrl: POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password (ForgotPasswordRequest)\n activate AuthCtrl\n AuthCtrl->>AuthSvc: ForgotPasswordAsync(request)\n activate AuthSvc\n \n AuthSvc->>UOW: Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Email == email)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>AuthSvc: Return User Entity (or null)\n deactivate UOW\n \n alt User Active & Email Confirmed\n AuthSvc->>AuthSvc: Generate 6-digit OTP ResetToken & Expiry (15 mins)\n activate UOW\n AuthSvc->>UOW: SaveChangesAsync()\n UOW-->>AuthSvc: DB Save Success\n deactivate UOW\n \n AuthSvc->>EmailSvc: SendPasswordResetEmailAsync(email, name, resetToken)\n activate EmailSvc\n EmailSvc-->>AuthSvc: Email Dispatched\n deactivate EmailSvc\n end\n \n AuthSvc-->>AuthCtrl: Execution Complete\n deactivate AuthSvc\n AuthCtrl-->>Client: 202 Accepted (\"If email exists, reset link sent\")\n deactivate AuthCtrl\n\n %% 2. Reset Password Sub-flow\n note over Client, UOW: User submits 6-digit OTP ResetToken & New Password\n Client->>AuthCtrl: POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password (ResetPasswordRequest)\n activate AuthCtrl\n AuthCtrl->>AuthSvc: ResetPasswordAsync(request)\n activate AuthSvc\n \n AuthSvc->>UOW: Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Email == email)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>AuthSvc: Return User Entity\n deactivate UOW\n \n AuthSvc->>AuthSvc: Verify ResetToken & ResetTokenExpiresAt\n alt Invalid or Expired Token\n AuthSvc-->>AuthCtrl: Throw AppException(400, \"Invalid or expired reset token\")\n AuthCtrl-->>Client: 400 Bad Request Response\n else Reset Token Valid\n AuthSvc->>Hasher: Hash(request.NewPassword)\n activate Hasher\n Hasher-->>AuthSvc: Return newPasswordHash\n deactivate Hasher\n \n AuthSvc->>AuthSvc: Update PasswordHash & Increment TokenVersion\n \n activate UOW\n AuthSvc->>UOW: RevokeActiveRefreshTokens(userId)\n AuthSvc->>UOW: SaveChangesAsync()\n UOW-->>AuthSvc: DB Save Success\n deactivate UOW\n \n AuthSvc-->>AuthCtrl: Reset Success\n deactivate AuthSvc\n AuthCtrl-->>Client: 200 OK (\"Password reset successfully\")\n end\n deactivate AuthCtrl",
 "config": null

'#ffffff'}}}%%\nsequenceDiagram\n autonumber\n actor Customer as Customer (App/Web)\n participant RentalsCtrl as RentalsController\n participant RentalSvc as RentalService\n participant UOW as UnitOfWork\n\n Customer->>RentalsCtrl: POST /api/v1/rentals (CreateTrayRentalRequest)\n activate RentalsCtrl\n RentalsCtrl->>RentalSvc: CreateAsync(userId, request)\n activate RentalSvc\n\n RentalSvc->>UOW: Supplies.FirstOrDefaultAsync(s => s.SupplyId == seedId)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>RentalSvc: Return Seed Supply Entity\n deactivate UOW\n\n RentalSvc->>UOW: BeginSerializableTransactionAsync()\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>RentalSvc: Return Transaction Context\n\n RentalSvc->>UOW: LockAvailableTraysAsync(quantity, farmAreaId)\n UOW-->>RentalSvc: Return Available Trays List\n deactivate UOW\n\n alt Insufficient Trays Available\n RentalSvc-->>RentalsCtrl: Throw AppException(409, \"Only X tray(s) available\")\n RentalsCtrl-->>Customer: 409 Conflict Response\n else Sufficient Capacity Available\n RentalSvc->>RentalSvc: Create Order (Status = AwaitingPayment, ExpiresAt = Now + 30m)\n RentalSvc->>RentalSvc: Mark Trays Status = Rented & Add TrayRental Lines\n \n activate UOW\n RentalSvc->>UOW: Orders.Add(order)\n RentalSvc->>UOW: SaveChangesAsync()\n RentalSvc->>UOW: Transaction.CommitAsync()\n UOW-->>RentalSvc: DB Transaction Committed\n deactivate UOW\n\n RentalSvc-->>RentalsCtrl: Return OrderResponse\n deactivate RentalSvc\n RentalsCtrl-->>Customer: 201 Created (ApiResponse<OrderResponse>)\n end\n deactivate RentalsCtrl\n",

 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'themeVariables': { 'primaryColor': '#ffffff', 'primaryTextColor': '#000000', 'primaryBorderColor': '#000000', 'lineColor': '#000000', 'actorBkg': '#ffffff', 'actorBorder': '#000000', 'actorTextColor': '#000000', 'signalColor': '#000000', 'signalTextColor': '#000000', 'labelBoxBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'labelBoxBorderColor': '#000000', 'labelTextColor': '#000000', 'loopTextColor': '#000000', 'noteBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'noteBorderColor': '#000000', 'noteTextColor': '#000000', 'activationBorderColor': '#000000', 'activationBkgColor': '#ffffff'}}}%%\nsequenceDiagram\n autonumber\n actor Cron as System Expiry Worker / Cron\n participant OrderSvc as OrderService\n participant UOW as UnitOfWork\n\n Cron->>OrderSvc: ExpireAwaitingPaymentAsync(now)\n activate OrderSvc\n\n OrderSvc->>UOW: Orders.Query().Where(OrderStatus == AwaitingPayment && ExpiresAt <= now).Include(TrayRentals)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>OrderSvc: Return Expired Orders List\n deactivate UOW\n\n alt No Expired Orders Found\n OrderSvc-->>Cron: Return (0 expired orders)\n else Expired Orders Exist\n loop For Each Expired Order\n OrderSvc->>OrderSvc: Set OrderStatus = Expired\n loop For Each Assigned TrayRental\n OrderSvc->>OrderSvc: Set SoilTray.CurrentStatus = Available\n OrderSvc->>OrderSvc: Set TrayRental.CropStatus = Cancelled\n end\n end\n\n activate UOW\n OrderSvc->>UOW: SaveChangesAsync()\n UOW-->>OrderSvc: DB Save Success (Capacity Released)\n deactivate UOW\n\n OrderSvc-->>Cron: Execution Complete (Expired Orders Processed)\n end\n deactivate OrderSvc",
 "config": null

value="<font style=""><font style="font-size: 35px;"><b style="">Sequence Diagram 1 :&nbsp;VietQR Generation &amp; Payment Status Polling Flow</b></font></font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="140" width="1570" x="-140" y="-180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'config': {'mirrorActors': false}, 'themeVariables': { 'primaryColor': '#ffffff', 'primaryTextColor': '#000000', 'primaryBorderColor': '#000000', 'lineColor': '#000000', 'actorBkg': '#ffffff', 'actorBorder': '#000000', 'actorTextColor': '#000000', 'signalColor': '#000000', 'signalTextColor': '#000000', 'labelBoxBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'labelBoxBorderColor': '#000000', 'labelTextColor': '#000000', 'loopTextColor': '#000000', 'noteBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'noteBorderColor': '#000000', 'noteTextColor': '#000000', 'activationBorderColor': '#000000', 'activationBkgColor': '#ffffff'}}}%%\nsequenceDiagram\n autonumber\n actor Customer as Customer (App/Web)\n participant PaymentsCtrl as PaymentsController\n participant PaymentSvc as PaymentService\n participant UOW as UnitOfWork\n\n %% 1. VietQR Code Generation Flow\n Customer->>PaymentsCtrl: GET /api/v1/payments/qr/{orderId}\n activate PaymentsCtrl\n PaymentsCtrl->>PaymentSvc: GetSePayQrAsync(userId, orderId)\n activate PaymentSvc\n\n PaymentSvc->>UOW: Orders.FirstOrDefaultAsync(o => o.OrderId == orderId && o.CustomerId == userId)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>PaymentSvc: Return Order Entity (or null)\n deactivate UOW\n\n alt Order Not Found or Expired\n PaymentSvc-->>PaymentsCtrl: Throw AppException(404, \"Order not eligible for payment\")\n PaymentsCtrl-->>Customer: 404 Not Found / 400 Bad Request Response\n else Order Eligible for Payment\n PaymentSvc->>PaymentSvc: Generate VietQR Image URL (OrderCode, TotalAmount, BankAcc)\n PaymentSvc-->>PaymentsCtrl: Return VietQrResponse (QrCodeUrl, OrderCode, Amount)\n deactivate PaymentSvc\n PaymentsCtrl-->>Customer: 200 OK (ApiResponse<VietQrResponse>)\n end\n deactivate PaymentsCtrl\n\n %% 2. Payment Status Polling Sub-flow\n note over Customer, UOW: Client polls payment status every 3 seconds after scanning QR code\n loop Every 3 Seconds (Until Confirmed or Expired)\n Customer->>PaymentsCtrl: GET /api/v1/payments/status/{orderId}\n activate PaymentsCtrl\n PaymentsCtrl->>PaymentSvc: CheckPaymentStatusAsync(userId, orderId)\n activate PaymentSvc\n \n PaymentSvc->>UOW: Orders.FirstOrDefaultAsync(o => o.OrderId == orderId && o.CustomerId == userId)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>PaymentSvc: Return Current Order Entity\n deactivate UOW\n \n alt Status == Confirmed or Expired\n PaymentSvc-->>PaymentsCtrl: Return PaymentStatusResponse (Status, ConfirmedAt)\n PaymentsCtrl-->>Customer: 200 OK -> Client Stops Polling\n else Status == AwaitingPayment\n PaymentSvc-->>PaymentsCtrl: Return PaymentStatusResponse (Status = Pending)\n deactivate PaymentSvc\n PaymentsCtrl-->>Customer: 200 OK -> Client Continues Polling\n deactivate PaymentsCtrl\n end\n end",
 "config": null

value="<font style=""><font style="font-size: 35px;"><b style="">Sequence Diagram 2 :&nbsp;</b></font></font><span style="font-size: 35px;"><b>SePay Bank Transfer Webhook Processing &amp; Order Confirmation</b></span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="140" width="1570" x="480" y="-140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'config': {'mirrorActors': false}, 'themeVariables': { 'primaryColor': '#ffffff', 'primaryTextColor': '#000000', 'primaryBorderColor': '#000000', 'lineColor': '#000000', 'actorBkg': '#ffffff', 'actorBorder': '#000000', 'actorTextColor': '#000000', 'signalColor': '#000000', 'signalTextColor': '#000000', 'labelBoxBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'labelBoxBorderColor': '#000000', 'labelTextColor': '#000000', 'loopTextColor': '#000000', 'noteBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'noteBorderColor': '#000000', 'noteTextColor': '#000000', 'activationBorderColor': '#000000', 'activationBkgColor': '#ffffff'}}}%%\nsequenceDiagram\n autonumber\n actor SePay as SePay Gateway (Bank Webhook)\n participant PaymentsCtrl as PaymentsController\n participant PaymentSvc as PaymentService\n participant UOW as UnitOfWork\n\n %% 1. Webhook Reception & Signature Verification\n SePay->>PaymentsCtrl: POST /api/v1/payments/webhook (SePayWebhookPayload)\n activate PaymentsCtrl\n PaymentsCtrl->>PaymentSvc: ProcessSePayWebhookAsync(payload, signature)\n activate PaymentSvc\n\n PaymentSvc->>PaymentSvc: Verify Cryptographic Webhook Signature\n alt Invalid Webhook Signature\n PaymentSvc-->>PaymentsCtrl: Throw AppException(401, \"Invalid webhook signature\")\n PaymentsCtrl-->>SePay: 401 Unauthorized Response\n else Valid Webhook Signature\n %% 2. Idempotency Check\n PaymentSvc->>UOW: Payments.FirstOrDefaultAsync(p => p.TransactionCode == payload.TransactionId)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>PaymentSvc: Return Existing Payment Entity (or null)\n deactivate UOW\n\n alt Transaction Already Processed (Idempotent Duplicate)\n PaymentSvc-->>PaymentsCtrl: Return Success (\"Duplicate webhook ignored\")\n PaymentsCtrl-->>SePay: 200 OK Response\n else New Bank Transfer Transaction\n %% 3. Order Matching & Payment Confirmation\n PaymentSvc->>PaymentSvc: Parse OrderCode from Transaction Content\n PaymentSvc->>UOW: Orders.FirstOrDefaultAsync(o => o.OrderCode == code && o.OrderStatus == AwaitingPayment)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>PaymentSvc: Return Order Entity (or null)\n deactivate UOW\n\n PaymentSvc->>PaymentSvc: Validate Transferred Amount (payload.Amount >= order.TotalAmount)\n\n alt Order Not Found OR Underpaid\n PaymentSvc->>UOW: Payments.Add(new Payment { Status = Exception, ... })\n activate UOW\n PaymentSvc->>UOW: SaveChangesAsync()\n UOW-->>PaymentSvc: DB Save Success\n deactivate UOW\n PaymentSvc-->>PaymentsCtrl: Return Success (\"Logged for staff review\")\n PaymentsCtrl-->>SePay: 200 OK Response\n else Order Matched & Fully Paid\n PaymentSvc->>PaymentSvc: Set Order.OrderStatus = Confirmed\n PaymentSvc->>UOW: Payments.Add(new Payment { Status = Success, TransactionCode = payload.TransactionId })\n activate UOW\n PaymentSvc->>UOW: SaveChangesAsync()\n UOW-->>PaymentSvc: DB Save Success (Order Confirmed)\n deactivate UOW\n \n PaymentSvc-->>PaymentsCtrl: Return Success (\"Payment confirmed\")\n PaymentsCtrl-->>SePay: 200 OK Response\n end\n end\n end\n deactivate PaymentSvc\n deactivate PaymentsCtrl",
 "config": null
}" id="noXJrGBJ-DxS4jerhepw-1"> <mxCell connectable="0" parent="1" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'config': {'mirrorActors': false}, 'themeVariables': { 'primaryColor': '#ffffff', 'primaryTextColor': '#000000', 'primaryBorderColor': '#000000', 'lineColor': '#000000', 'actorBkg': '#ffffff', 'actorBorder': '#000000', 'actorTextColor': '#000000', 'signalColor': '#000000', 'signalTextColor': '#000000', 'labelBoxBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'labelBoxBorderColor': '#000000', 'labelTextColor': '#000000', 'loopTextColor': '#000000', 'noteBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'noteBorderColor': '#000000', 'noteTextColor': '#000000', 'activationBorderColor': '#000000', 'activationBkgColor': '#ffffff'}}}%%\nsequenceDiagram\n autonumber\n actor ESP32 as ESP32 Device\n participant TelemetryCtrl as DeviceTelemetryController\n participant TelemetrySvc as TelemetryService\n participant UOW as UnitOfWork\n\n %% 1. Device Authentication\n ESP32->>TelemetryCtrl: POST /api/v1/iot/telemetry (Header: X-Device-Key, Body: TelemetryIngestRequest)\n activate TelemetryCtrl\n TelemetryCtrl->>TelemetryCtrl: AuthorizeDevice() (Validate X-Device-Key)\n\n alt Invalid X-Device-Key\n TelemetryCtrl-->>ESP32: 401 Unauthorized Response\n else Valid X-Device-Key\n TelemetryCtrl->>TelemetrySvc: IngestAsync(request)\n activate TelemetrySvc\n\n %% 2. Idempotency Check\n TelemetrySvc->>UOW: SensorTelemetry.FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.DeviceId == deviceId && x.MessageId == messageId)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>TelemetrySvc: Return Existing Telemetry (or null)\n deactivate UOW\n\n alt MessageId Already Processed (Duplicate Message)\n TelemetrySvc-->>TelemetryCtrl: Return TelemetryResponse\n TelemetryCtrl-->>ESP32: 200 OK Response\n else New Telemetry Message\n %% 3. Device & Tray Assignment Verification\n TelemetrySvc->>UOW: IoTDevices.FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.DeviceCode == code)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>TelemetrySvc: Return IoTDevice Entity\n deactivate UOW\n\n TelemetrySvc->>UOW: TrayDevices.FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.DeviceId == id && x.IsActive)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>TelemetrySvc: Return TrayDevice Assignment Entity\n deactivate UOW\n\n TelemetrySvc->>TelemetrySvc: Validate(request) (Check Temperature, Humidity, WaterLevel limits)\n\n alt Device Inactive, Unassigned, or Sensor Out of Range\n TelemetrySvc-->>TelemetryCtrl: Throw AppException(400/409/404)\n TelemetryCtrl-->>ESP32: 400 Bad Request / 409 Conflict Response\n else All Validations Pass\n TelemetrySvc->>TelemetrySvc: Update Device.LastSeen = UtcNow & Device.Status = Online\n \n activate UOW\n TelemetrySvc->>UOW: SensorTelemetry.Add(newTelemetry)\n TelemetrySvc->>UOW: SaveChangesAsync()\n UOW-->>TelemetrySvc: DB Save Success\n deactivate UOW\n\n TelemetrySvc-->>TelemetryCtrl: Return TelemetryResponse\n TelemetryCtrl-->>ESP32: 200 OK (ApiResponse<TelemetryResponse>)\n end\n end\n deactivate TelemetrySvc\n end\n deactivate TelemetryCtrl\n",
 "config": null

mermaidData="{
 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'config': {'mirrorActors': false}, 'themeVariables': { 'primaryColor': '#ffffff', 'primaryTextColor': '#000000', 'primaryBorderColor': '#000000', 'lineColor': '#000000', 'actorBkg': '#ffffff', 'actorBorder': '#000000', 'actorTextColor': '#000000', 'signalColor': '#000000', 'signalTextColor': '#000000', 'labelBoxBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'labelBoxBorderColor': '#000000', 'labelTextColor': '#000000', 'loopTextColor': '#000000', 'noteBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'noteBorderColor': '#000000', 'noteTextColor': '#000000', 'activationBorderColor': '#000000', 'activationBkgColor': '#ffffff'}}}%%\nsequenceDiagram\n autonumber\n actor Customer as Customer (App/Web)\n participant TelemetryCtrl as CustomerTelemetryController\n participant TelemetrySvc as TelemetryService\n participant UOW as UnitOfWork\n\n Customer->>TelemetryCtrl: GET /api/v1/rentals/{rentalId}/telemetry/latest\n activate TelemetryCtrl\n TelemetryCtrl->>TelemetrySvc: LatestCustomerAsync(userId, rentalId)\n activate TelemetrySvc\n\n %% 1. Rental Ownership Verification\n TelemetrySvc->>UOW: TrayRentals.FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.RentalId == id && x.CustomerId == userId)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>TelemetrySvc: Return TrayRental Entity (or null)\n deactivate UOW\n\n alt Rental Contract Not Found / Unauthorized Access\n TelemetrySvc-->>TelemetryCtrl: Throw AppException(404, \"Rental not found\")\n TelemetryCtrl-->>Customer: 404 Not Found Response\n else Rental Contract Verified\n TelemetrySvc->>TelemetrySvc: Extract SoilTrayId from TrayRental\n \n %% 2. Latest Telemetry Retrieval & Stale Data Calculation\n TelemetrySvc->>UOW: SensorTelemetry.Where(x => x.SoilTrayId == trayId).OrderByDescending(x => x.RecordedAt).FirstOrDefaultAsync()\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>TelemetrySvc: Return Latest SensorTelemetry Record (or null)\n deactivate UOW\n\n alt Telemetry Record Not Found\n TelemetrySvc-->>TelemetryCtrl: Throw AppException(404, \"Telemetry not found\")\n TelemetryCtrl-->>Customer: 404 Not Found Response\n else Telemetry Record Found\n TelemetrySvc->>TelemetrySvc: Compute IsStale = (UtcNow - RecordedAt > 5 mins)\n TelemetrySvc-->>TelemetryCtrl: Return TelemetryResponse (IsStale = true/false)\n TelemetryCtrl-->>Customer: 200 OK (ApiResponse<TelemetryResponse>)\n end\n end\n deactivate TelemetrySvc\n deactivate TelemetryCtrl",
 "config": null

 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'config': {'mirrorActors': false}, 'themeVariables': { 'primaryColor': '#ffffff', 'primaryTextColor': '#000000', 'primaryBorderColor': '#000000', 'lineColor': '#000000', 'actorBkg': '#ffffff', 'actorBorder': '#000000', 'actorTextColor': '#000000', 'signalColor': '#000000', 'signalTextColor': '#000000', 'labelBoxBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'labelBoxBorderColor': '#000000', 'labelTextColor': '#000000', 'loopTextColor': '#000000', 'noteBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'noteBorderColor': '#000000', 'noteTextColor': '#000000', 'activationBorderColor': '#000000', 'activationBkgColor': '#ffffff'}}}%%\nsequenceDiagram\n autonumber\n actor Broker as IoT Sensor / MQTT Broker\n participant MqttSvc as MqttService\n participant IoTSvc as IoTManagementService\n participant UOW as UnitOfWork\n\n Broker->>MqttSvc: Publish Telemetry (smartfarm/telemetry/{deviceId})\n activate MqttSvc\n MqttSvc->>IoTSvc: EvaluateThresholdRulesAsync(deviceId, telemetry)\n activate IoTSvc\n\n %% 1. Query Assigned Tray & Threshold Rule\n IoTSvc->>UOW: TrayDevices.FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.DeviceId == deviceId)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>IoTSvc: Return TrayDevice (with SoilTray & CropId)\n deactivate UOW\n\n IoTSvc->>UOW: CropThresholds.FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.CropId == cropId)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>IoTSvc: Return CropThreshold Entity\n deactivate UOW\n\n %% 2. Evaluate Rule & Trigger Actuator\n IoTSvc->>IoTSvc: Compare Telemetry vs Min/Max Bounds\n\n alt Threshold Breached (e.g., Soil Moisture < Min)\n IoTSvc->>MqttSvc: PublishControlCommandAsync(actuatorCode, \"ON\")\n MqttSvc->>Broker: MQTT Publish (smartfarm/control/{actuatorCode}, {\"state\":\"ON\"})\n \n activate UOW\n IoTSvc->>UOW: ActuatorLogs.AddAsync(actuatorLog)\n IoTSvc->>UOW: SaveChangesAsync()\n UOW-->>IoTSvc: DB Transaction Committed\n deactivate UOW\n else Telemetry Within Optimal Range\n IoTSvc->>IoTSvc: No Action Required\n end\n\n deactivate IoTSvc\n deactivate MqttSvc",
 "config": null

 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'config': {'mirrorActors': false}, 'themeVariables': { 'primaryColor': '#ffffff', 'primaryTextColor': '#000000', 'primaryBorderColor': '#000000', 'lineColor': '#000000', 'actorBkg': '#ffffff', 'actorBorder': '#000000', 'actorTextColor': '#000000', 'signalColor': '#000000', 'signalTextColor': '#000000', 'labelBoxBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'labelBoxBorderColor': '#000000', 'labelTextColor': '#000000', 'loopTextColor': '#000000', 'noteBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'noteBorderColor': '#000000', 'noteTextColor': '#000000', 'activationBorderColor': '#000000', 'activationBkgColor': '#ffffff'}}}%%\nsequenceDiagram\n autonumber\n actor User as User (App/Web)\n participant IoTCtrl as IoTManagementController\n participant IoTSvc as IoTManagementService\n participant MqttSvc as MqttService\n participant UOW as UnitOfWork\n participant Broker as MQTT Broker / Actuator\n\n User->>IoTCtrl: POST /api/v1/iot/devices/{deviceId}/control\n activate IoTCtrl\n IoTCtrl->>IoTSvc: SendManualCommandAsync(userId, deviceId, dto)\n activate IoTSvc\n\n %% 1. Device Ownership & Tray Assignment Verification\n IoTSvc->>UOW: TrayDevices.FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.DeviceId == deviceId)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>IoTSvc: Return TrayDevice Entity (or null)\n deactivate UOW\n\n alt Device Assignment Not Found / Unauthorized\n IoTSvc-->>IoTCtrl: Throw AppException(404, \"Device not found\")\n IoTCtrl-->>User: 404 Not Found Response\n else Device & Ownership Verified\n %% 2. Dispatch Control Command via MQTT\n IoTSvc->>MqttSvc: PublishControlCommandAsync(deviceCode, dto.Action)\n activate MqttSvc\n MqttSvc->>Broker: MQTT Publish (smartfarm/control/{deviceCode}, payload)\n deactivate MqttSvc\n\n %% 3. Record Audit Log\n activate UOW\n IoTSvc->>UOW: ActuatorLogs.AddAsync(actuatorLog)\n IoTSvc->>UOW: SaveChangesAsync()\n UOW-->>IoTSvc: DB Transaction Committed\n deactivate UOW\n\n IoTSvc-->>IoTCtrl: Return CommandResultDto\n IoTCtrl-->>User: 200 OK (ApiResponse<CommandResultDto>)\n end\n\n deactivate IoTSvc\n deactivate IoTCtrl",
 "config": null

 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'config': {'mirrorActors': false}, 'themeVariables': { 'primaryColor': '#ffffff', 'primaryTextColor': '#000000', 'primaryBorderColor': '#000000', 'lineColor': '#000000', 'actorBkg': '#ffffff', 'actorBorder': '#000000', 'actorTextColor': '#000000', 'signalColor': '#000000', 'signalTextColor': '#000000', 'labelBoxBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'labelBoxBorderColor': '#000000', 'labelTextColor': '#000000', 'loopTextColor': '#000000', 'noteBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'noteBorderColor': '#000000', 'noteTextColor': '#000000', 'activationBorderColor': '#000000', 'activationBkgColor': '#ffffff'}}}%%\nsequenceDiagram\n autonumber\n actor Staff as Staff (App/Web)\n participant CultCtrl as CultivationController\n participant CultSvc as CultivationService\n participant UOW as UnitOfWork\n\n Staff->>CultCtrl: POST /api/v1/staff/cultivation/cycles\n activate CultCtrl\n CultCtrl->>CultSvc: StartCycleAsync(request)\n activate CultSvc\n\n %% 1. Validate Soil Tray & Seed Supply\n CultSvc->>UOW: SoilTrays.FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.SoilTrayId == id)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>CultSvc: Return SoilTray Entity (or null)\n deactivate UOW\n\n alt Soil Tray Not Available / Invalid Seed\n CultSvc-->>CultCtrl: Throw AppException(409, \"Tray not available\")\n CultCtrl-->>Staff: 409 Conflict Response\n else Soil Tray Available & Seed Validated\n %% 2. Create Growing Cycle\n activate UOW\n CultSvc->>UOW: TrayRentals.AddAsync(trayRental)\n \n %% 3. Generate Daily Staff Care Tasks\n CultSvc->>UOW: CareSchedules.Where(x => x.SupplyId == supplyId).ToListAsync()\n UOW-->>CultSvc: Return CareSchedule Templates\n CultSvc->>CultSvc: GenerateTasksAsync(rentalId, schedules)\n CultSvc->>UOW: DailyTasks.AddRangeAsync(dailyTasks)\n \n CultSvc->>UOW: SaveChangesAsync()\n UOW-->>CultSvc: Transaction Committed\n deactivate UOW\n\n CultSvc-->>CultCtrl: Return Created TrayRental Entity\n CultCtrl-->>Staff: 201 Created (ApiResponse<TrayRental>)\n end\n\n deactivate CultSvc\n deactivate CultCtrl",
 "config": null

id="yy8MsFt7S-Yge_9Lr5Nn-0" /> <mxCell id="yy8MsFt7S-Yge_9Lr5Nn-1" parent="yy8MsFt7S-Yge_9Lr5Nn-0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'config': {'mirrorActors': false}, 'themeVariables': { 'primaryColor': '#ffffff', 'primaryTextColor': '#000000', 'primaryBorderColor': '#000000', 'lineColor': '#000000', 'actorBkg': '#ffffff', 'actorBorder': '#000000', 'actorTextColor': '#000000', 'signalColor': '#000000', 'signalTextColor': '#000000', 'labelBoxBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'labelBoxBorderColor': '#000000', 'labelTextColor': '#000000', 'loopTextColor': '#000000', 'noteBkgColor': '#ffffff', 'noteBorderColor': '#000000', 'noteTextColor': '#000000', 'activationBorderColor': '#000000', 'activationBkgColor': '#ffffff'}}}%%\nsequenceDiagram\n autonumber\n actor User as Customer / Staff (App/Web)\n participant DelivCtrl as DeliveriesController\n participant DelivSvc as DeliveryService\n participant UOW as UnitOfWork\n\n User->>DelivCtrl: PUT /api/v1/deliveries/orders/{orderId}/schedule\n activate DelivCtrl\n DelivCtrl->>DelivSvc: ScheduleCustomerAsync(userId, orderId, request)\n activate DelivSvc\n\n %% 1. Verify Order & Delivery Eligibility\n DelivSvc->>UOW: Orders.FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.OrderId == orderId)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>DelivSvc: Return Order Entity (or null)\n deactivate UOW\n\n alt Order Not Found / Invalid Status / Invalid Time\n DelivSvc-->>DelivCtrl: Throw AppException(409/400)\n DelivCtrl-->>User: 409 / 400 Error Response\n else Order Confirmed & Valid Schedule Time\n %% 2. Process Delivery Record Creation / Reschedule\n DelivSvc->>UOW: Deliveries.FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.OrderId == orderId)\n activate UOW\n UOW-->>DelivSvc: Return Delivery Entity (or null)\n deactivate UOW\n\n %% 3. Update Status & Commit Transaction\n activate UOW\n alt Delivery Record Not Found\n DelivSvc->>UOW: Deliveries.AddAsync(delivery)\n end\n DelivSvc->>UOW: Orders.UpdateStatus(OrderStatus.Preparing)\n DelivSvc->>UOW: SaveChangesAsync()\n UOW-->>DelivSvc: Transaction Committed\n deactivate UOW\n\n DelivSvc-->>DelivCtrl: Return DeliveryResponse DTO\n DelivCtrl-->>User: 200 OK (ApiResponse<DeliveryResponse>)\n end\n\n deactivate DelivSvc\n deactivate DelivCtrl",
 "config": null

+SaveChangesAsync() Task~int~\n }\n\n class User {\n +int UserId\n +string Email\n +string PasswordHash\n +string FullName\n +string PhoneNumber\n +string Address\n +string Role\n +bool IsActive\n
